entries.name: Rondo Days
entries.capsule: St. Paul festival honoring Rondo, the Black neighborhood cut in half by Interstate 94.
entries.dateRule: Held on the third Saturday of July in St. Paul (WCCO, 2024), with the date set each year by Rondo Avenue Inc.

dates.source: MPR News, July 15, 2026 ('this Saturday from noon to 7:00'), and the Summit-University Planning Council listing (12-7 p.m., MLK Center; the date is misprinted there as 'July 18, 2926')
Calculated as the third Saturday of July; not yet announced
Calculated as the third Saturday of July; not yet announced

entries.whatItMarks: The Rondo neighborhood and its families, displaced by I-94 construction from 1956 to 1968. First held in July 1983.
entries.howCelebratedInMinnesota: In 2026: Martin Luther King Jr. Recreation Center, St. Paul, noon to 7 p.m., with live music, more than 18 food trucks, 30-plus vendors, a youth zone and a morning seniors brunch. The festival was not held from 2020 through 2023 and later returned after a five-year gap. Rondo Avenue Inc., established in 1982, presented the 2026 festival with Kwamé and Bahamadia, DJs, food and a youth zone powered by the St. Paul Sports Club. In 2024 it opened with a 10 a.m. parade near St. Peter Claver Church.
